question: In MS Word 365, what is the shortcut to remove manual character formatting from selected text?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ctrl + Spacebar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + Spacebar** is the shortcut used in **MS Word 365** to remove manual character formatting from selected text.
 
• This action restores the selected text to the **default formatting** applied by the paragraph style.
 
• Manual character formatting includes **font styles**, **font sizes**, **bold**, **italic**, **underline**, and other direct formatting changes.
 
• Using this shortcut ensures that the selected text adheres to the **consistent formatting** of the overall document.
 
• **MS Word 365** provides various shortcuts to streamline formatting tasks, enhancing user productivity.
 
• This shortcut is particularly useful in situations where the text has been formatted inconsistently or requires a uniform style for professional appearance.
 
• **Ctrl + Spacebar** is supported across different versions of **Microsoft Word**, making it a universal formatting tool for users.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ctrl + Shift + N**__

 __
 
• **Ctrl + Shift + N** is used to apply the **Normal style** to the selected text in MS Word.
 
• The **Normal style** is the default paragraph style for new documents and includes predefined font and spacing settings.
 
• This shortcut is different from **Ctrl + Spacebar**, as it applies a style rather than removing manual character formatting.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + Z**__
 __
 
• **Ctrl + Z** is the shortcut for the **Undo**
 
• It reverses the last action performed by the user, whether it is text editing, formatting, or other changes.
 
• This shortcut does not remove character formatting but instead undoes recent modifications.
 
 
 
• **Ctrl + B**__
 
 
• **Ctrl + B** is used to apply or remove **bold formatting** to the selected text.
 
• This shortcut is specific to bold styling and does not remove other manual formatting changes.
 
• It is commonly used for emphasizing text in documents.
